name: FORM — redesign (v2 views + pot banks)
convention: key 0 = AUX; keys 1-10 = black keys (top row); keys 11-26 = white keys (16-step row). '#000000' = off. v2 model: single-engine 8-track sequencer (no machine types); knobs = per-track POT BANK (bank set in track menu); 4 VIEWS (Mix/Step/Transpose/Notes) on AUX 13-16; always 16 steps, 4 pages/track. Step view: top row 3-10 = 8 step-edit modes; hold a step -> value palette on 1-10; hold a mode key -> default on 11-20. See FORM_REDESIGN.md.
notes: Proposal draft. Single-engine 8-track sequencer. Step view top row (3-10) = 8 step-edit modes: Note(orange) Velocity(yellow) StepLength(green) Repeat(cyan) Chance(blue) Math(purple) Function(magenta) MIDIFX(rose); active bright, others dim. Hold a step -> top row 1-10 = value palette for the active mode (Note = 10 notes, chromatic-from-C or in-scale); AUX-while-holding = reset step to default. Hold a mode key -> keys 11-20 = the mode's DEFAULT value. Knobs still P-Lock CCs. Step row: LTBLUE=notes, DKBLUE=empty, WHITE=playhead. See FORM_REDESIGN.md.

states.name: Mix view (mixing / performance)
states.notes: Mix = mixing/performance, not step editing. Keys 3-10 = the 8 tracks in their track colors (seqColors): selected=WHITE, muted=RED, empty=dim, fired=INDIGO. Track: tap=select, double-click=enter Step, HOLD=per-track controls on the low row (see form_mix.json). F1=Mute, F2=Solo modifiers (F1/F2 + tap a track); F3(F1+F2)=track rate. LOW ROW (11-26) = the selected track's pattern: tapping a step PLAYS that step's PROGRAMMED notes (jam the sequence, not a chromatic keyboard); hold F1 + a step = toggle that step's mute. (Live chromatic play = MI view.) Knobs = track pot bank.

keyNotes.3: Track 1 — selected (WHITE). Double-click=open Step; hold=controls; F1+tap=mute; F2+tap=solo
keyNotes.11: Low row = selected track's pattern; tap a step = play its programmed notes; F1+tap=step mute

encoder.note: Turn = select param (incl. Pot Bank); AUX+turn = edit

screen.note: Top row = 5-seg CC meter; track summary

states.name: Step — mode selector (top row 3-10)
states.notes: Locked to one track. Top row keys 3-10 = 8 step-edit modes: 3 Note(active, ORANGE), 4 Velocity, 5 Step Length, 6 Repeat, 7 Chance, 8 Math, 9 Function, 10 MIDI FX (inactive shown dim in their hues). Tap to pick the mode. Step row = current page pattern (Note mode: LTBLUE=has notes, DKBLUE=empty, WHITE=playhead key15). Now hold a step to set its value (state 3), or hold a mode key to set the default (state 4).

states.name: Step — hold a step (value palette 1-10)
states.notes: Holding step 4 (key15, WHITE) with Note mode active: the TOP ROW keys 1-10 become the note palette. Chromatic from C in the current octave: 1=C(root, periwinkle), 2=C#, 3=D, 4=D#, 5=E, 6=F, 7=F#(this step's note, LTYELLOW), 8=G, 9=G#, 10=A; in-scale mode would show only scale notes. Tap a key to set the step's note. Press AUX (while holding) = reset the step to the mode default. Turning a pot-bank knob still P-Locks a CC.

keyNotes.7: Value = F# — this step's current note (LTYELLOW)
keyNotes.15: Held step (WHITE). Press AUX = reset to default

pots.label: K1
pots.note: Pot bank CC21 (turn = P-Lock this step)

encoder.note: Optional fine-tune of the value while held

states.name: Step — hold a mode key (set default 11-20)
states.notes: Holding the Note mode key (key3, bright) sets the mode's DEFAULT value on keys 11-20 (the value used by steps with no explicit override). Same 10-note palette, now on the low row: 11=C(root), 16=current default note (LTYELLOW), etc. Keys 21-26 unused. Other mode keys stay dim on the top row.

keyNotes.3: Note mode — HELD (bright), setting its default
keyNotes.20: Default value palette ends at key 20

states.name: Step + F3 — set page length
states.notes: Holding F3 (F1+F2, keys 1&2 LTCYAN/MINT) sets the CURRENT page's length: tap a STEP key for how many steps the page has. Here length=12, so keys 23-26 (steps 13-16) go dark. The mode row (3-10) is inactive while F3 is held. (Which pages LOOP + page select now live on the AUX page keys 6-9, not here.)

states.name: Notes view (chord/note entry)
states.notes: Full chord/note editor (deeper than the Step Note mode). Keyboard STARTS at F4 (key15): piano = keys 3-10 (sharps) + 15-26 (naturals), F4-C6. C major example: roots (C5=19,C6=26) periwinkle, in-scale whites dim blue, out-of-scale sharps off. Chord C5-E5-G5 lit LTYELLOW. F1(1)=copy step, F2(2)=paste step; hold F1+F2=jump-to-step. Key11=prev, Key12=next (one per click), Key13=unused, Key14=clear. Live MIDI audition on hold when stopped. OLED: 5-seg CC meter + 16 step-boxes + page number.

encoder.note: Turn = change step (0-63); step flashes on change

states.name: Transpose view
states.notes: Per-step transpose lane within the page length (len=9; 20-26 off): TZERO #0000ff=0, THIGH #8080ff=up, TLOW #000020=down. Shortcuts: key3 random-arm, key9 randomize, key10 clear, keys1/2 = F1/F2 copy/cut.

encoder.note: Turn = select step; AUX+turn = edit transpose

states.name: AUX layer (held) — same everywhere
states.notes: Holding AUX shows one control layer in every view (see form_aux.json for the full labeled layout). key0=AUX(RED). 1=Play(GREEN), 2=Reset(ORANGE). 3=REC arm (RED when armed), 4=rec mode (overdub/replace). 6-9 = pages: P1 playing(YELLOW flash), P2 selected(GREEN), P3 in-loop(BLUE), P4 muted(very dim). 11/12=octave. 13-18 = views Mix/Step/Transpose/Notes/Patterns/MI (current flashes WHITE=Step key14). No pot-bank/MIDI-FX here. While holding a STEP, AUX resets that step to the mode default.
